# NEUS

> Portable Trust Infrastructure for people and AI. One private profile for identity, context, permissions, and proof that works across apps, agents, services, and transactions.

Don't restart from zero. Every app makes you reconnect yourself, rebuild context, re-prove ownership, and reconfigure permissions. NEUS changes that with one private profile that travels with you. Prove once, carry it with you, let any system verify it when it matters. Connected gates check current state before access, payment, or execution. Built for people and AI.

## What NEUS does

- **Portable proofs:** A reusable verification asset for identity, ownership, or permission. Show it on a profile, require it for access, or confirm it through the API. Same proof, every surface.
- **Gates:** Proof-based access to content, rewards, and member areas, with optional USDC or card checkout.
- **Agent trust:** Verifiable agent identity, controller-approved authority, spend caps, and expiration. Checked before tools run.
- **Unique-person checks:** Reuse proof-of-human and wallet-risk results across a product.
- **MCP for assistants:** One setup writes supported editor configuration and signs the user in with OAuth. Same identity, provenance, and authority in Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, and VS Code.
- **Trust workflow skill:** https://github.com/neus/network/blob/main/sdk/skills/neus-trust-workflow/SKILL.md (canonical source, shipped in `@neus/sdk` and bundled in the `neus-mcp` plugin)
- **Integrate skill:** https://github.com/neus/network/blob/main/sdk/skills/neus-integrate/SKILL.md (add NEUS access control to an app: gate, server check, and test flow)

## Quick start

Install the SDK and wire MCP for your editor:

```bash
npx -y -p @neus/sdk neus setup
npx -y -p @neus/sdk neus doctor --live
```

Then ask your assistant: "Use NEUS Verify before taking sensitive actions."

## Pricing summary

- Free (Basic): 500 credits / month
- Pro: $19.99 / month (or $199.90 / year), 10,000 credits / month
- Enterprise: Custom, 500,000+ credits / month. Contact https://neus.network/contact?topic=Enterprise
- Credit rate: $0.0025 per credit (USD)
- x402 pay-per-call: when credits run short, NEUS returns HTTP 402 with a signed quote; pay (USDC or native ETH) and retry with one header.
- Full details: https://neus.network/pricing

## Verifier catalog (14 public checks)

ownership-basic, ownership-social, ownership-pseudonym, ownership-dns-txt, ownership-org-oauth, proof-of-human, wallet-risk, wallet-link, nft-ownership, token-holding, contract-ownership, ai-content-moderation, agent-identity, agent-delegation

## Standard

Wallet-signed request envelopes follow the CAIP-380 (Portable Proof) ChainAgnostic draft. Their hash, DID binding, and signature can be verified without NEUS. Verifier outcomes remain part of the NEUS portable proof; session-authorized proofs are not CAIP-380 envelopes.
